description: This file contains Django view functions for the 'jwql' web application, handling webpage rendering, data retrieval, and API responses related to JWST data visualization and management.

methods.name: anomaly_query
methods.description: Handles the anomaly query form page, processes form data, updates configuration, and redirects to submit page.

methods.name: miri_data_trending
methods.description: Generates the MIRI data trending webpage with dashboard components.

methods.name: nirspec_data_trending
methods.description: Generates the NIRSpec data trending webpage with dashboard components.

methods.name: about
methods.description: Renders the about page with acknowledgements.

methods.name: api_landing
methods.description: Renders the API landing page.

methods.name: archived_proposals
methods.description: Displays a page listing all archived proposals for a specified instrument.

methods.name: archived_proposals_ajax
methods.description: Returns JSON data about archived proposals for a specified instrument.

methods.name: archive_thumbnails
methods.description: Displays thumbnails for a specific proposal.

methods.name: archive_thumbnails_ajax
methods.description: Returns JSON data for thumbnails of a specific proposal.

methods.name: archive_thumbnails_query_ajax
methods.description: Returns JSON data for thumbnails based on current anomaly query configuration.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates the dashboard webpage with various plots and tables.

methods.name: engineering_database
methods.description: Renders the engineering database page.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports specified database table as CSV download.

methods.name: home
methods.description: Renders the home page with file search form.

methods.name: instrument
methods.description: Displays instrument tool index page with documentation URL.

methods.name: jwqldb_table_viewer
methods.description: Displays database table viewer, optionally with selected table data.

methods.name: not_found
methods.description: Renders a 404 not found page.

methods.name: query_submit
methods.description: Displays the query submission confirmation page with current query parameters.

methods.name: unlooked_images
methods.description: Placeholder for listing unlooked images (not implemented).

methods.name: view_header
methods.description: Displays header information for a specified FITS file.

methods.name: view_image
methods.description: Displays image and anomaly form for a specified file.
